description: This file declares functions for managing the hierarchy of command names in a git-related process environment, including appending to and retrieving the command name hierarchy, as well as releasing resources.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_append_hierarchy
methods.description: Appends the current command name to the hierarchy maintained in the environment.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_get_hierarchy
methods.description: Retrieves the command name hierarchy for the current process.

methods.name: tr2_cmd_name_release
methods.description: Releases resources associated with command name hierarchy management.
